scheme_name: Reimbursement of College Fees for Scheduled Caste Students in Professional Colleges (Top 20)
other_conditions: Must be a student who has secured a place in the Top 20 rank
Must have secured at least 75% in the Higher Secondary Course Examination
Must have been selected through CENTAC for admission to a professional college
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of tuition and examination fees.
